versions.changelog:
- Version bumped from 1.3.0 to 1.3.1.
- Documentation updated in SKILL.md; minor clarifications and edits.
- Obsolete skill-card.md file removed.

- Reference docs moved into a new "references/" directory (tests.md, mocking.md, refactoring.md, deep-modules.md, and interface-design.md).
- All references and links in SKILL.md updated to use the new "references/" directory location.
- Obsolete top-level documentation files removed.
- Added a new script: scripts/validate_spec.py.

- Initial public release of the execute-spec skill, supporting version 1.3.0.
- Implements the TDD workflow driven strictly by an approved SPEC SDD.
- Offers clear step-by-step guidance: reading the SPEC, slicing work by requirements, running the red-green-refactor loop.
- Ensures all user communication is in Portuguese; internal reasoning remains in English.
- Enforces best practices: tests map directly to SPEC requirements, public seam testing only, one slice at a time with immediate validation.
- Integrates with related skills including write-specs and qa-analyst for a full QA workflow.
